official_context.repeal: Regulation (EU) 2024/1781 Article 79 repeals Directive 2009/125/EC subject to transitional exceptions.
official_context.transition: Article 79(1)(a) preserves a grouped set of old provisions temporarily 'instead of' a grouped set of provisions in the new Regulation. This is official regime-level transition evidence, not a one-to-one Article 1 lineage mapping.

adversarial_signal.safe_conclusion: These signals justify a lineage candidate for review, not an asserted provision-lineage edge.

confidence.rationale: Similarity and act-level succession do not establish one-to-one provision ancestry; Article 79 supplies grouped transitional context but no Article 1 mapping.
